描述_ZN: Guanyin" scroll, modern, painted by Fu Baoshi, on paper, color, 110.1 cm in length and 34.5 cm in width.　　The painting is self-titled: "Written on the tenth day of the seventh month of the year jiashen, in the south xuan of the south of the mountain zhai of the lower Jingyan slope in Dongchuan. Baoshi." Inscription: "Baishi's seal" in white, "Fu" in vermilion, "Yinshi" in vermilion, "Its life is new " and "Baoshi Zhai" in vermilion.　　The year is 1944.　　Guanyin is a Buddhist bodhisattva, the left-hand attendant of Amitabha Buddha, one of the "Three Western Saints". Buddhism depicts him as the bodhisattva of great compassion, saying that if beings in distress chant his name, "the bodhisattva instantly observes his sound" and goes to rescue and liberate, hence the name (see "Dharma Flower Sutra - Pu Men Pin"). Because the name of Emperor Taizong Li Shimin was kept secret in the Tang Dynasty, the word "Shi" was removed and the name "Guanyin" was slightly used. The original body of Guanyin was male, but after Buddhism was introduced to China, the statue of Guanyin in China was transformed into a female body since the North and South Dynasties, and continues to this day.　　The figure of Guanyin holding a willow branch of the vase, dignified and steady, kind eyes, eyes with deep emotion, seems to be looking down on the deep in the fire and suffering of the multitude of beings, is trying to save the suffering. Very little drawing Buddhist subject matter Fu Baoshi in the war beacon picture writing this both compassionate heart, boundless power of the bodhisattva, showing the painter to the early end of the war, so that 40,000,000 compatriots out of the sea of suffering good hope.　　This picture is Fu Baoshi's wife Luo Shihui donated.
